prompt: Create an issue for the code change (draft only, do not post): the station's settings are sorted. One config for each station holds everything the operator sets; one hidden store holds what the software keeps across sessions and never shows; each frontend has a config of its own; definition files (strategies, lists, country file) and data files (logbook, recording) stay files of their own. A setting belongs to the part that uses it. The Settings page groups by object and has an Advanced menu with Diagnostics.
